episodes.title: Day 10: the harbour lit a lantern festival, the boat got her name, and the sea sent apple seeds
episodes.beat: HERRING wins 11 to 5: Sando's boat is The Herring, planked overnight, but she has no skipper. The harbour won the race to twenty homes, so the Harbour Lantern Festival lights up tonight, and the high street gets its first benches. Jim's most-liked idea: the carpenters' guild (Toxin, Gumpy, Mahdi; Bram applies). Seven move in: Bob Smith the blacksmith (a coincidence, he says), Ivorskal the storytelling smith, Sir Zeus, Thomas the combat trainer, Uly the chef, Tristan's chickens and Yash the milkman. Lucy opens a tavern, Soul is the village blacksmith, Nico has a cabbage stall. At dusk a parcel of apple seeds washes ashore. Vote: who skippers The Herring, SANDO or GOM?

episodes.title: Day 9: Bram laid a keel, a windmill turns, and Slaxx fished half a word out of the sea
episodes.beat: BRAM wins the boat vote 17 to 1 and lays the keel of Sando's fishing boat; she has no name yet. Three hundred lanterns lit: the Lantern Mill turns on the farms, which open today. Twenty-eight move in: Twigs the Wizard alone in a tower deep in the forest, Samuel the statue maker, Mustafa's cafe, Yuni the fisher (or fish), Bobbert the cowboy and the first farmers, and more. Crug joins the crew. Slaxx rows Sam out to the buoys and they fish up half an old sign with half a word on it. Vote: name the boat, HERRING or GULL?

episodes.title: Day 8: the YouTube harbour sailed in, and two harbours became one village
episodes.beat: The YouTube harbour sails in: Crug, Barold, Loops, Uros, Gom, Alissa, Cassandra and Lemmie move in with their lookout, bread oven, warm pool and the Wreck Shop; two harbours become one village building one ship. Their vote settles it: the one beacon burns DRIFTWOOD (4 to 0), and Crug takes up woodcutting. SLAXX wins the rowboat 7 to 2, rows past the buoys and brings back an empty corked bottle. Sixteen more move in (Luke, Koorthon, John, Nicolas, Isaiah, Taco Man, Mr Pinkiepie, Bruno, Dylan, Syfer, Mr A, Soul, Theo, Sara, Jason, Wolf), the market fills up, fifty villagers bring cobbled roads, and harbour reaches 20 homes first. Two hundred lanterns lit: the Wall Observatory. Deni's most-liked idea: a lantern by every tent. Vote: who builds the fishers' boat, BRAM or JIM?

episodes.title: Day 7: you lit a hundred lanterns, so the beacon on the hill is burning tonight
episodes.beat: A hundred lanterns lit, so Bram lights the Hill Beacon. HARBOUR won the homes vote 4 to 1, and eleven move in: Silver Knight, Ram and his bear Cheeseburger, MacGillian the night watchman, JhonDeStickman the blacksmith, Nugget, Salar the teacher, Toxin in his gas mask, Kory the knight, Hussein the librarian, Uncle George the shepherd and Jie the weapon trader. Stefi's idea got the most likes: Chung Yang gets his dojo and a straw hat. The ship gets its ribs; stone paths start. An empty rowboat drifts in at dusk, oars neatly stowed. Vote: who takes it out, SLAXX or SANDO?

episodes.title: Day 6: something out in the fog lost a sock, and it's too big even for our giant
episodes.beat: Nobody voted on what Jim builds first (DOJO 0, WELL 0), so Morten picked the WELL; Chung Yang says he trains anywhere. Jim dug the Village Well by lunch while Bram held the bucket. 95 lanterns lit, five short of the beacon. Harbour and shipyard start a race for a lantern festival. An enormous sock washes ashore at dusk, too big even for Valerion; the cat sits beside it. Vote: where do the next homes go, HARBOUR or SHIPYARD?

episodes.title: Day 5: a carpenter built a three-storey house in a week, and the cat is hiding somewhere in this video
episodes.beat: Jim the carpenter (a three-storey house in a week), Deni the witch-healer, Adrian the quiet stranger, Tim Tim the watchmaker and Chung Yang the blind swordsman move in. The coin vote tied, COSI 1, SLAXX 1: Morten tossed a coin and Cosi keeps it; Slaxx wanted to cut it in half. Stefi gets a cowboy hat and a watchtower. The cat hides in the tavern chair. The ship has eighteen planks. A jar of honey washes ashore; nobody here keeps bees. Vote: what does Jim build first, a DOJO or a WELL?

episodes.title: Day 4: a 250-year-old elf moved in, and the sea sent a coin he says is older than him
episodes.beat: Stefi the hunter, Sam the coffee-making mage, Kamina the healer and Cosi the 250-year-old elf move in. Ten villagers: Bram lights the first street lamp. Slaxx gives the chair to the cat, his first customer, and joins the crew. The ship has thirteen planks. A very old coin washes ashore; Slaxx claims it, Cosi doesn't know the face on it. Vote: who keeps the coin, COSI, SLAXX or the SHIP?

episodes.title: Day 3: a gentle giant moved in, a pirate opened a tavern, and the sea sent us a chair
episodes.beat: Valerion, a gentle giant of a monastery guard, moves in by the shipyard; Darajh decides not to challenge him. Slaxx opens the Treasure Turtle Tavern and sells 'sea rum'. The ship has nine planks. A dry chair washes out of the fog; the cat sits in it first.

episodes.title: Day 2: five villagers moved in, and the sea sent a crate a pirate swears is his treasure
episodes.beat: The first five villagers move in: Sando, Veg E. Table, Roan D. Loe, Slaxx and Darajh. The ship has eight planks. A crate washes ashore; Slaxx thinks it is his treasure, but it is full of confused crabs.

episodes.title: Day 1: the sea brought us a bottle that says hello
episodes.beat: Last Harbor is three: Old Morten, Bram and the cat. The ship gets its first three planks. A bottle washes ashore with one word inside: Hello?

founders.trait: Sees things in the fog. Writes them all down.
Has talked to the ship more than to people.
Belongs to no one. Turns up everywhere.

villagers.trait: Catches fish for everyone. Determined to tame the cat.
Grows vegetables for a shawarma shop that doesn't exist yet.
Gives the cat check-ups. The cat never booked one.
Hunting his old crew's treasure, buried by a turtle-shaped rock.
Has never met his match. Nobody here wants a fight.
A gentle giant. Carries a sword he hopes never to need.
A hunter whose first catch went straight to the cat.
Could rule the world with magic. Makes coffee instead.
Grows his own herbs, brews potions, always needs volunteers.
A 250-year-old high elf. Collects what the world forgot.
Black suit, few words. Nobody knows his past. Nobody asks.
Just a little guy making watches. Always knows the time.
A witch whose spells only ever make people feel better.
Blind swordsman. Fights only if attacked. Prefers the lute.
Built a three-storey wooden house in one week.
Throws cat food everywhere he goes. The cat pretends not to notice.
Tames animals. His pet bear is called Cheeseburger.
Keeps the night watch. Sleeps through every sunny afternoon.
Signed up with a skull. Hammers very cheerfully anyway.
Proudly unemployed. Works very hard at it.
Teaches anyone who sits still long enough.
Never takes off his gas mask. Nobody knows why.
A knight who'd rather climb a mast than wear a dress.
Has read every book in the village. Both of them.
Herds sheep in his white pleated uniform. The sheep approve.
Sells swords to people who promise never to use them.
Reformed barbarian. These days he only fights stuck jar lids.
His cargo ship hit our rocks. Now he sells whatever floated.
Loves the water, can't swim a stroke. Keeps the hives close anyway.
Came from the army. Still marches everywhere, even to breakfast.
Not the brightest. First catch was a boot. Wears it, crab included.
Came to sell herbal remedies. Has one for absolutely everything.
Counts everything twice. Gave the speech that made the Wreck Shop.
Calls it fog research. Mostly it's chanting at the fog.
A firefighter. The only fire in town is the beacon.
Trains dogs to help the village. Hoards bones for them.
The best surfer in the village. There are no waves. He waits.
A doctor who'll try any cure. Some are very odd.
A Grim Reaper on holiday. Mostly he reaps the wheat.
Runs a taco stand. Bram has had four today.
Inspects every house. Says Bram's ship doesn't count.
Rich businessman. Wants a house shaped like the planet Mars.
Owns the biggest library here. Gives advice on everything else.
A librarian in a village with more libraries than books.
Learned all of medicine so everyone here lives well.
Forges armour for the village. Keeps a secret. Won't say which.
Moved in, asked nicely, and went straight down to fish.
Opened her own flower shop. Hands every newcomer a flower.
Sells jewellery. Swears every pearl came from a real oyster.
Makes bows and arrows. Has never lost a single arrow.
Practises magic alone. Nobody knows if it's real or just Twigs.
Carves statues, has hair like a cloud, wants a stone fox.
Opened a cafe. Sam calls it competition, very politely.
Joined library number five. Still hunting for a third book.
A merchant in a fine red coat. Barold is nervous.
Trains lizards. So far, one turtle. It's going well.
Slays monsters. Hasn't found one yet. Checks under the pier daily.
Makes rum. Slaxx swears his sea rum is better.
Investigates everything. Already keeps a file on the cat.
A woodworker. Bram has already asked for twelve planks.
The seventh healer in town. Nobody here is even ill.
Bakes the bread and grows the wheat, right beside the bakery.
Shouts the news every morning, even when there isn't any.
Asked very politely to be a knight. Now he is one.
The village archer. Wolf already made him a bow.
A mechanic in a village with no machines. Fixes things anyway.
Asked to be a fisher, then decided a fish was fine too.
A carpenter. Bram follows him around too now.
Came from space. Lost the spaceship. Won't talk about it.
Nobody writes letters yet, so he delivers hellos.
Bakes pastries in a bookshop. There are crumbs in every book.
The gentlest gardener here. Nobody knows where the name came from.
Leads the village army. The army is mostly Uros.
Moved in to fish, just in time for the new boat.
First farmer on the new farms. Picked the best field.
The full name won't fit on the sign. Raaga, for short.
A cowboy raising cows. Lenny the horse is on the way.
Building a cabbage empire, one cabbage at a time.
Keeps chickens. Asked where his house was. Here it is.
A soldier. Uros finally has someone to march with.
A blacksmith called Smith. Swears it's a coincidence.
Runs combat training. The knights finally have homework.
Forges by day, tells legends by night. They grow every telling.
A chef. Taco Man and Mustafa are watching very closely.
Delivers milk before sunrise. Nobody's sure whose cow it is.

props.name: Treasure Turtle Tavern
props.description: Slaxx's tavern. The sea rum is crab juice, seawater and seaweed. It burns.

props.name: Stefi's Flag
props.description: Stefi brought it from home. It flaps at the cat to say dinner's ready.

props.name: The Tavern Chair
props.description: Washed out of the fog bone dry. Slaxx confiscated it. The cat sits in it.

props.name: Sando's Fish Traps
props.description: Six traps, set by Sando. He says one of them is for the cat.

props.name: Veg's Shawarma Sign
props.description: The vegetables are ready. The shawarma shop is not. Veg E. Table is patient.

props.name: Jim's Timber Pile
props.description: Timber waiting for the horse cart Jim is building to carry it. Bram is already measuring the wheels.

props.name: Taco Man's Stand
props.description: The first stall in the market. Bram had four tacos and called it lunch for the ship.

props.name: Slaxx's Rowboat
props.description: Won seven to two. Slaxx rowed past the buoys and came back with a bottle. He calls it treasure.

props.name: The Carpenters' Guild
props.description: Jim's idea got the most likes. Toxin, Gumpy and Mahdi joined. Bram is still applying.

props.name: Mahdi's Furniture Shop
props.description: Chairs, tables, shelves. Bram asked if any of it floats.

props.name: Nico's Cabbage Stall
props.description: The cabbage empire has a shop front now. One cabbage at a time.

landmarks.name: The Village Well
landmarks.description: Nobody voted, so Morten picked the well. Jim dug it in a morning, and Bram held the bucket like it was a plank.

history.text: Nobody voted, so Morten picked the well. Jim dug it in a morning, and Bram held the bucket like it was a plank.

landmarks.name: The Hill Beacon
landmarks.description: Every like lit a lantern, and a hundred lanterns lit this. Bram climbed up and lit it himself.

history.text: Every like lit a lantern, and a hundred lanterns lit this. Bram climbed up and lit it himself.
Day 7: a hundred lanterns lit, so Bram lit the beacon. It burns toward the wall.

landmarks.name: The Wishing Tree
landmarks.description: The oldest tree in the village. People tie a ribbon on it for every wish, and nobody says what they wished for.

history.text: The oldest tree in the village. People tie a ribbon on it for every wish, and nobody says what they wished for.

landmarks.name: The Bee Bench
landmarks.description: Three straw hives by the fields. The bees were here first, so the village built them a bench.

history.text: Three straw hives by the fields. The bees were here first, so the village built them a bench.

landmarks.name: The Bandstand
landmarks.description: A striped roof went up on the green west of the market overnight. Nobody owns up to it, but someone keeps humming under it.

history.text: A striped roof went up on the green west of the market overnight. Nobody owns up to it, but someone keeps humming under it.

landmarks.name: The Wreck Shop
landmarks.description: Barold's cargo ship, stuck on our rocks. You voted SHOP, so now it sells whatever floated. Some crates in the hold are still nailed shut.

history.text: Barold's cargo ship, stuck on our rocks. You voted SHOP, so now it sells whatever floated. Some crates in the hold are still nailed shut.

landmarks.name: The Bread Oven
landmarks.description: A stone oven for the whole village. It has been warm every morning since it was built.

history.text: A stone oven for the whole village. It has been warm every morning since it was built.

landmarks.name: The Warm Pool
landmarks.description: Steam rising between the trees: a pool of warm water in the rocks. Nobody has been brave enough to get in yet.

history.text: Steam rising between the trees: a pool of warm water in the rocks. Nobody has been brave enough to get in yet.

landmarks.name: The Lookout
landmarks.description: A wooden tower on the hill, so whoever climbs it can see the whole village at once. The ladder creaks on rung seven.

history.text: A wooden tower on the hill, so whoever climbs it can see the whole village at once. The ladder creaks on rung seven.

landmarks.name: The Wall Observatory
landmarks.description: Two hundred lanterns built this: a dome with a telescope aimed at the wall, day and night. Lemmie booked the first night.

history.text: Two hundred lanterns built this: a dome with a telescope aimed at the wall, day and night. Lemmie booked the first night.
Day 8: two hundred lanterns lit, so the observatory went up and its lamp came on. Lemmie hasn't left it since.

landmarks.name: The Lantern Mill
landmarks.description: Three hundred lanterns built it, on the day the farms opened. It grinds flour for the bread oven.

history.text: Three hundred lanterns built it, on the day the farms opened. It grinds flour for the bread oven.
Day 9: the sails got their cloth and started turning before breakfast.

landmarks.name: The Herring
landmarks.description: Sando's idea, Bram's keel, and your name: HERRING won eleven to five. Planked now. She still needs a skipper.

history.text: Bram won the vote seventeen to one and laid her keel by sunrise. Sando's idea. She has no name yet.
Day 10: you named her The Herring, eleven to five, and Bram planked her the same night.

landmarks.name: The Harbour Lantern Festival
landmarks.description: The harbour won the race to twenty homes, so the village strung up flags and lanterns. Nobody wants to take them down.

history.text: The harbour won the race to twenty homes, so the village strung up flags and lanterns. Nobody wants to take them down.
Day 10: the lanterns went up at dusk, one for every home in the harbour.
